tools.name: build_site_preview
tools.description: Builds a real, complete website preview for a small business from a one-sentence description (optionally its name and city), using AI Site Builder (sitebuilder.adcreator-ai.com). findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_site_preview · Public sink: build_site_preview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_site_preview · Public sink: build_site_preview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
